alive.last_commit_message:
feat(settings): Save stays on screen in every Global Settings form

API Keys & Tunneling showed Save Settings only after an edit, at the very
bottom of the tab, so every change ended in a scroll. Its header now sits
outside the card as a sticky bar (a sticky element only sticks inside its
parent, and this Save also covers the Tunneling section) with Save Settings
at the top right: shown once the settings loaded, disabled until something
changes, then lit with an "Unsaved changes" note.

The LLM provider form and the MCP Server create/edit token forms move
Cancel and Save from their bottom into a sticky header; the MCP Tool
Plugins editor's header, which already held them, becomes sticky; the
Tradecraft resource modal moves them into the Modal's fixed footer (the
submit button reaches the form through its id). Wrapped header actions
stay on the right edge.

A test pins the keys tab Save: in the header beside Import Keys, disabled
before an edit, enabled with the note after one, disabled again after a
save. The settings test files pass (vitest), the type check is clean, and a
browser check against the rebuilt image measured every Save in view at the
top, middle and bottom of each scrolling form.
